_comment: Data-driven CREATIVE AD GENERATOR for Defenders of the Realm / Echoes of Elarion. Generates store-screenshot + headline + body promo creatives from EXISTING game records (hero/pack/feature/weapon) — owner data-first style: an ad is a TEMPLATE bound to a SUBJECT record, not a hand-authored one-off. The thin AdCreativeGenerator interpreter (WORK_ORDER_ad_generator.md §B) reads templates[], picks a subject row from the named canonical catalog, fills {tokens}, and emits an AdSpec (the 'generated' array below holds 3 worked samples). Output AdSpec feeds: store ASO screenshots, in-game cross-promo cards, and external creative export.

_sources.screens: captured via the headless screenshot fleet (run-defenders skill) — see screenshotRecipe

_schema.template: { id, format (enum: square_1080|portrait_1080x1920|landscape_1200x628|app_store_card), subjectType (enum: hero|pack|weapon|feature), headlinePattern (string w/ {tokens}), bodyPattern (string w/ {tokens}), ctaPattern (string), screenshotRecipe { scene, camera, subjectBinding, overlays[] }, palette (FK->brand theme), tokens[] (which subject fields are interpolated), audience (enum: acquisition|reengagement|monetization) }
_schema.tokenSources: {token} resolves from the subject record's fields by path, e.g. {name},{tagline},{pricing.usd},{rarity},{flavor}; plus brand tokens {brand.title},{brand.tagline}; missing token -> generator logs FlowTrace.Warn and drops the clause (never ships a literal {token}).
_schema.adSpec: GENERATED output: { id, templateId, subjectId, format, headline, body, cta, screenshot { path, scene, status }, palette, audience, generatedAtNote }
